Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.ftpclient.model

Class SiteProfile

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.ftpclient.model.SiteProfile
public class SiteProfile extends Object
A saved remote site: everything needed to reach one FTP / FTPS / SFTP server.

This is a plain Jackson-serializable bean (no-arg constructor plus getters/setters) persisted by ProfileStore as JSON. It deliberately carries no live connection; opening one is the job of the net layer, so a profile is cheap to create, copy, edit and store.

The password is optional and, by default, not persisted: a profile keeps it only when isSavePassword() is true, in which case ProfileStore stores an obfuscated (not strongly encrypted) form. The id is a stable identifier assigned on construction so profiles can be renamed without losing their identity. The default protocol is Protocol.FTPS so a freshly created site is secure unless the user deliberately downgrades it.
